exposure: Infants with RDS requiring surfactant (cases) vs. infants not treated with surfactant (controls)
Gastric fluid metabolites (L-proline, L-glycine, L-threonine, acetyl-L-serine)
cohort: 73 very preterm infants (43 with RDS requiring surfactant and 30 without surfactant treatment).
finding: While significant differences in certain gastric fluid metabolites were found between infants who did and did not receive surfactant therapy, no single metabolite could accurately predict the need for surfactant; however, a model combining clinical variables and gastric fluid metabolites showed moderate predictive value.
gest_age: Very preterm (specific gestational age range not provided)
